objective_catalog.name: total_capital

objective_catalog.name: cas27
objective_catalog.note: CAS27 special-materials capital, computed in-package from the radial-build blanket volume since the model migration (2026-08-21). Declared as an objective so generic verification compares it against the oracle's own recompute: on the era route this value was glue-fed to both sides and never independently verified.

objective_catalog.name: beta
objective_catalog.note: Volume-averaged thermal beta computed by 'Volume-Averaged Beta' from the profile referents and magnet__B (WI-030); replaces the retired bound input beta. Compared against the oracle's closed form so a magnet study verifies the physics lever it moves.

objective_catalog.name: magnet_capital
objective_catalog.note: CAS22.1.3 magnet capital — since WI-035 the decomposed rollup (winding pack + casing structure), the channel the plant's magnet.capital_cost reads. The old conductor-proxy lump is the separate magnet_capital_1cfe comparison objective.

objective_catalog.name: magnet_capital_1cfe
objective_catalog.note: 1cfe-form comparison channel (WI-035 D6): the retained 'Magnet Coil Cost' conductor-proxy lump, now responding to the computed field. Kept as an objective so the decomposed rollup and the calibrated lump stay observable side by side.

objective_catalog.name: p_aux_required

oracle.note: Package-owned oracle seam. evaluate(point) takes a mapping of qualified entry keys to floats and returns a mapping of qualified channel names to floats; it wraps the independent pure-Python oracle verify_stellaris.py, whose current live radius operands follow model-owned plant R. ANNEX.md section Current oracle comparison coverage lists the seventeen native channels outside its 141-channel map. The module also publishes a fixed-name companion, operand_bindings() -> {constraint_id: {source_name: {kind, key}}}, which says which qualified input key or channel each predicate operand means. A generic verifier requires both and fails closed on anything unresolved: on this package one operand of five constraints resolves to nothing by name at all, so a tool that inferred bindings would compare the wrong number and read as a pass.

effective_executable_fingerprint.note: Strict native loader; sealed executable identity

baseline_preparation: Strict direct evaluation, no store; explicit nil sentinel provenance in baseline_result.json. Ordinary baseline is a real case in the sole store.
gaps: Generated executable package and complete runtime installation are not copied. Re-execution requires the stated sealed package/runtime identities.
No fresh diagnostic execution; original adverse cases are retained with provenance.
No independent oracle computation for the 17 disclosed channels, or arbitrary override support for the 147 disclosed inputs.
Administrator synthesis and parent freeze commit are separate subsequent actions.
